## 关联 Issue / Related issue

<!-- 如有相关 Issue，请填写编号或链接；没有则留空。
Link a related issue if one exists, or leave this section blank. -->

## 问题与目的 / Problem and purpose

<!-- 说明触发条件、当前行为和期望结果。
Describe the trigger, current behavior, and expected result. -->

## 修改内容 / Changes

<!-- 说明实现思路、修改效果及受影响的平台或功能；界面调整可附前后截图。
Describe the implementation approach, resulting behavior, and affected platforms or features. Add before-and-after screenshots for UI changes when helpful. -->

## 验证结果 / Validation

<!-- 列出实际完成的检查、测试命令和结果；涉及人工验证时说明系统与操作步骤，未验证的内容请明确注明。
List the checks and test commands you ran and their results. For manual verification, include the system and steps. Clearly identify anything not verified. -->
